read.note: digest of the relied-on method map; file bytes are not pinned so that the result changes only when what the App relies on changes
read.role: host source (identity of what was derived from it)

rules.finding_id: VA- and the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the finding's kind, subject and the SHA-256 of its exact old and new content (null where absent), so a disposition stops applying when the change is other than the one decided
rules.findings: each needs a disposition: a relied-on or reached definition changed, added or removed; a relied-on method's member of its method union changed; a relied-on method removed; a standing change of a relied-on element; a supplement element lost; for a relied-on method, a recorded group present at the prior pin and absent at the new pin, a shape difference of a recorded group, or a prior-pin recorded frame that fails validation against the new pin's schema
rules.identity: a definition is unchanged exactly when its parsed JSON value written canonically (object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, strings and numbers as Python's json writes them, so 1 and 1.0 differ) is the same text at both pins; nothing is stripped or normalised beyond that; otherwise it is changed, and its difference is listed path by path (object keys, list indexes; a list of different length is one difference), each value in full or, when its canonical text is longer than 1000 characters, by SHA-256 and length
rules.inadmissible: never disposable and each prevents passing: a missing or unusable input or one lacking a required structure; a recording lacking a step of its scenario's script in any generation (coverage_required); a new-pin recording not of the current format; a current-format recording whose socket_watch is absent or does not have samples an integer greater than zero, failed_samples exactly zero, samples_by_generation with at least one for every generation that has frames, non_loopback_peers empty and loopback_peers only 127.0.0.1 or ::1; a new-pin supplier notification or server request that fails validation against the new pin's schema; an expected mechanism not observed at the new pin
rules.inputs: each pin needs a main bundle whose definitions hold the four method unions with members naming their method and non-empty v2 definitions, a v2 bundle equal to the main bundle's v2 definitions in both directions (references rewritten to the flat form), a manifest listing files in both variants, and a recording of every scenario with frames; the host source must yield at least one relied-on method; an optional file that is absent is read as empty, a path that exists and cannot be read as a file is unusable
rules.relied_on: a protocol method is relied on when its exact name appears as a Rust string literal in the host source outside files ending _tests.rs and outside modules gated by #[cfg(test)] or #[cfg(all(test, ...))]; its root definitions are the params of a relied-on request or notification and the response of a relied-on request (<Name>Response for params <Name>Params, else the method's segments in PascalCase followed by Response); every definition reachable from a root by $ref at either pin is reached and compared like a root
rules.shape: per scenario and per supplier notification, server request and reply to a request: the set of key paths with their JSON value types and whether each path is present in every such frame; every scalar value is ignored (so identifiers, times, paths and text), as are array lengths, the order of array items and keys, and object keys that are UUIDs or digit strings (read as <id>)
rules.standing: read from MANIFEST.sha256 at file level: experimental exactly when the file is in json-schema/experimental and not json-schema/stable
rules.validation: jsonschema Draft 7 against the new pin's ServerNotification (supplier frames with a method and no id) and ServerRequest (supplier frames with an id and a method); the supplier's replies and the App's frames are not validated; formats are not asserted
rules.verdict: passed only when every finding has a disposition naming its identifier, every disposition names a finding of this comparison and nothing is inadmissible; otherwise returned for decision
